title: UNDERSTANDING THE WORLD TO SOLVE SOCIAL DILEMMAS USING MULTI-AGENT REINFORCEMENT LEARNING
reasoning: The paper investigates how world models in multi-agent reinforcement learning (RL) agents facilitate cooperation in social dilemmas like the 'tragedy of the commons'. It treats cooperation as a strategic outcome of game theory and RL rather than evaluating religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or formal systems of morals and ethics.
